minutes.headline: Personnel report shows far more staff departures than hires, mostly pay-driven amid budget uncertainty.
minutes.summary: This remote School Committee meeting closed out FY24 business: a $41,675 salary-to-expense line item transfer, approval of the FY24 encumbrance/open-PO list, and updates on the messy year caused by long-vacant town accountant and finance director positions. The committee also heard a lengthy concussion-protocol discussion with a guest sports-medicine physician, approved joining the Community Eligibility Provision for free meals at Turkey Hill, appointed a member (with backup) to a new town budget task force, and reviewed a personnel report describing many more staff separations than new hires, attributed largely to pay concerns following the district's recent budget-cut scare.

what_happened.line: A personnel report showed far more staff departures than new hires, attributed largely to pay concerns after the district's recent budget-cut scare.
The committee approved a transfer from salary lines to expense lines to close out the FY24 budget, made necessary by town accountant and finance director positions sitting vacant for months.
The committee approved the FY24 encumbrance list, holding a number of purchase orders open, some funded by grants or the school lunch revolving account rather than the general budget.
The committee voted to join the Community Eligibility Provision at Turkey Hill Elementary, which would let the school serve free meals to all students without meal-benefit applications.
A member was appointed, with a backup, to a newly formed town budget task force.

why_it_matters: Staff leaving over pay, even described only as a pattern here, touches classroom continuity and who is teaching students next year.
The salary-to-expense transfer and the vacant town finance positions behind it affect how reliably the district's books close each year, which residents rely on when judging the budget.
Joining the Community Eligibility Provision would change how families at Turkey Hill Elementary access school meals, regardless of income.
